headline: Adelphi end Southern New Hampshire's unbeaten run
dek: Adelphi beat Southern New Hampshire at home, the first defeat in fourteen matches for the conference leaders. Southern New Hampshire still sit six points clear of American International, who won at Saint Michael's on the same day.
displaced_by: Adelphi's win ended Southern New Hampshire's unbeaten season, so the standing dek's 'still unbeaten' is no longer true

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty goals come from at least fifteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Every programme has now lost at least once; Southern New Hampshire were the last, beaten at Adelphi.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored fourteen of Franklin Pierce's twenty-eight goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost nine matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won seven matches and lost six, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept six clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire's first defeat of the season; Adelphi had not won since beating Saint Anselm.

next_match.line: Saint Anselm have won every match since losing at Adelphi; Franklin Pierce's only conference defeat came at American International.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
